name: David Rosenberg
summary: David Rosenberg is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 15: Oil Is the Headline. The Real Yield Is the Bill.. Argued in Part 15 (Oil stays out of the core).

parts.headline: Oil Is the Headline. The Real Yield Is the Bill.

sides.sideLabel: Oil stays out of the core
sides.claim: He will not say inflation bulls are deranged and grants that inflation is always a very complex item to forecast with hundreds of variables, but says he sees nothing telling him a pernicious inflationary environment is coming.

sides.sideLabel: Oil stays out of the core
sides.claim: If real-time rents and home prices were plugged into the CPI it would be close to zero and core would be well below 2%, and he thinks that will come through with lags because shelter matters far more than energy in the CPI.
